title: Garry Nolan has seen little people and a craft

tellings.quote: he he has seen some little people. >> He's seen >> Yeah. And he's seen a craft, too.

plain: Garry Nolan, a Stanford scientist who has studied people and materials linked to UFO reports, has personally seen "some little people" and a craft, according to Michels. Michels says this on the show as something Nolan told him, without giving when or where it happened. If true, a respected scientist would be claiming to have seen non-human beings and their vehicle with his own eyes.
